head: codex/5663-runtime-v3-durable-local-adapters
title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][adapters] Implement durable local Runtime v3 adapters (#5663)
body:
## Summary

Implements #5663 durable local Runtime v3 adapters for Agent, Shepherd, Scheduler, Chronosense, CheckpointStore, and Lifelog. Production local adapters now perform bounded real local behavior instead of receipt-only or synthetic success. Provider, ACIP, A2A, and Cloud Bridge remain fail-closed pending their separate external transport scopes.

## Corrected Review Fixes

- Agent execution and canonical ingress dispatch use real bounded local work.
- Scheduler jobs retire after completion and remain reusable beyond repeated requests.
- CheckpointStore persists and restores real state bytes with principal identity and hash integrity verification.
- Cancellation uses live CancellationToken state, including duplicate in-flight waiter cancellation without poisoning owner execution or retry.
- Durable local state requires an explicit absolute configured root with unique writer locking, ownership-safe release, stale-lock recovery, and partial-lock recovery.
